fast.label: Fast
fast.sentence: DC, 50 kW and up. About 100 miles in 15 to 30 minutes at 150 kW or faster, closer to an hour at 50 kW.

slowdc.label: Slow DC
slowdc.sentence: DC under 50 kW: an older or low-power station, or a session the vehicle held back (cold or nearly full battery). About 100 miles takes an hour or more.

medium.label: Medium
medium.sentence: Level 2 (AC), 7 to 11 kWh per hour. About 15 to 30 miles per hour.

hotel.label: Hotel
hotel.sentence: Lists a Level 2 charger, which may be taken or out of date, so check with the hotel. If it's free and working, a night adds 100+ miles.

camping.label: Camping
camping.sentence: RV hookup. A 50-amp (14-50) site charges at Level 2 speed with a 240 V portable charger; a 30-amp site is much slower.

outlet.label: Outlet
outlet.sentence: Household outlet (120 V). About 3 to 4 miles per hour.
